topic: allocate a shareable DMA buffer on a vintage tree that still carries ION
q: On a 4.19-era BSP kernel, allocate a dma-buf backed buffer from kernel space for sharing with another device.
range: <= 5.10 (drivers/staging/android/ion was removed in 5.11; dma-buf heaps took over)
requires_tree: vintage BSP tree that still ships drivers/staging/android/ion with a kernel-side ion_alloc; upstream trees >= 5.11 have neither

corruptions.why: the dma-buf heaps replacement. Upstream it is internal to drivers/dma-buf and is not declared under include/ at all, so it is not a drop-in for ion_alloc in driver code.
same dma-buf heaps family; absent on this tree.

forbidden: assuming ION exists upstream - it is a downstream carry on vendor trees, and reading a vendor tree as evidence that mainline still has ION is exactly backwards
rubric: Uses the tree's kernel-side ion_alloc and manages the returned dma_buf reference. Notes that upstream this path is gone since 5.11 and dma-buf heaps are the successor, without claiming dma_heap_buffer_alloc is available here.
